decisions.reason: Candidate (main Feishu; merges 1-5 CLI/SSH/process-group/ProviderSpec/auth notes) and codex/rv-proxy-trust's trusted-proxy/listen/Origin note both insert at the top of Released. Manual union keeps all candidate entries then appends the proxy-trust entry before the shared tail, with blank-line separation between heading blocks.

Add/add: merge 5 (auth-hardening) and proxy-trust each added this new module. Retain parent2 (proxy-trust) wholesale. By design that branch owns the full module: its six shared primitives (_normalize_ip, _ip_matches_networks, _resolve_networks, direct_peer_is_trusted, client_ip_from_request, scheme_from_request) are byte-identical to the auth copy, and it additionally provides browser_origin_is_allowed, unsafe_http_request_is_allowed and reject_bad_websocket_origin. Git's add/add reconstruction (48cf526) is discarded in favor of the reviewed proxy-trust blob.

Union of both parents. Retain auth-hardening's public_url field (used by the Secure-cookie decision in api/auth.py) and the shared trusted_proxies/trusted_proxy_networks; add proxy-trust's allowed_origins, allow_insecure_listen, bind_host fields and allowed_origins_list property. Drop only the auth-side comment that said the Origin setting was 'intentionally not duplicated here', which is obsolete once proxy-trust is integrated.

Union of both parents. Keep the auth-hardening import and the import-time install_redacting_access_formatter() call that masks uvicorn access/WS logs, and add proxy-trust's unsafe_http_request_is_allowed import, the JSONResponse import, the lifespan listen-guard call, and the BrowserOriginGuardMiddleware class registered last so it is the outermost layer. The remaining auto-merged regions already place all of these without duplication.
